name: qkd_d2d_pf_ref-q13-c561acfaf
purpose: q13-kvh PF variant of q10 (prepared for a q10 TT miss on a buffer PUSH pin): every hard-buffer push pin driven by its own kept flop (ot_qkvd_pop_ff) whose D is the same class decode taken one relay stage earlier (cycle-identical to rb_push / ce_v, checked every cycle in simulation); OT_MPFLOP anchors pop AND push flops at the macro pins. q10 4_cts SS: rq2_v -> decode -> 155 ps unbuffered wire -> u_rb/push -262. Rest as q10 (PQ registered pops).
